description: 120 customer-feedback texts (reviews, tickets, social replies) for the NovaBook AI Pro 16, labelled positive / negative / neutral before the first measurement. No star ratings, so the text alone decides. Includes negation, contrast ('but'), Indian-English phrasing, emojis, typos, questions and mild sarcasm.
